name: file-preview
description: High-fidelity local file preview in the Antigravity sidebar for PPT (.pptx), Word (.docx with full-text search), Excel (.xlsx / .xls / .csv / .tsv with multi-sheet switching, formula bar, and merged cells), PDF (.pdf with >20MB HTTP Range streaming), MP4 (.mp4 with >20MB streaming playback), and HTML (.html / .htm), with automatic Chinese/English UI.
suggestedPrompts: Preview a local .pptx presentation, .docx document, or .xlsx spreadsheet in the File Preview sidebar
Inspect multi-sheet .xlsx / .xls / .csv / .tsv workbooks with formulas and merged cells in File Preview
Stream and preview large >20MB .pdf documents or .mp4 videos in File Preview
Preview a local .html web page in the isolated File Preview sidebar
